FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A01
Pre-drive checks run brakes, lamps, tires, glass, and dual mirrors past tint, then park, seat, mirrors, locks, belts [A01].
Why it matters: group pre-drive; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A01
Backing looks through glass with an arm turned, never trusting mirrors or cameras, and rolls slowly with spotters [A01].
Why it matters: group backing; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A02
Rear-flank corners hide from mirrors and need head turns, and truck zones dwarf car zones [A02].
Why it matters: group blind-spots; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F03 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A02
Perception and reaction each run three-quarters to one second, costing 55 feet at 50 MPH [A02].
Why it matters: group stopping; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A02
Braking spans 158 feet at 50 MPH, squares with doubled speed, and totals 268 feet with human delays [A02].
Why it matters: group stopping; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R04; confusables sec07-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A03
Four seconds minimum by marker count stretches for rain, dark, passes, loads, and hills [A03].
Why it matters: group following; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F06 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A04
Fire trucks keep 500 feet, truck pairs keep 300, and tailgated drivers slow rightward [A04].
Why it matters: group gaps; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F07, sec07-F08 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A04
Intersections clear by arrival with right-side ties, and two-way turners trail straight traffic [A04].
Why it matters: group intersections; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F08 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A04
Driveways yield to everything, and open crossings yield to occupants, highways, pavement, and left-turn conflicts [A04].
Why it matters: group yields; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F09 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A05
Roundabouts circle counterclockwise with entry yields, no swaps or stops, signaled exits, and lane-split multi rings [A05].
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F10 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A05
Limited roads bar walkers, bikes, and small scooters, and entries signal, accelerate, and merge with yields [A05].
Why it matters: group highways; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F11 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec07-R12 | anchor: A06
Exits signal right and slow on ramps, cruisers plan mile exits, and breakdowns clear pavement within six hours [A06].
Why it matters: group highways; difficulty low; prereq sec07-R11; confusables sec07-F12 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R13 | anchor: A07
Ramp backing is banned except past wrong-way signs and red reflectors, which force retreat [A07].
Why it matters: group ramps; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F13 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R14 | anchor: A07
Wide roads vacate lanes or slow 20 under, two-lanes slow 20 under, and 20-limit roads crawl 5 [A07].
Why it matters: group move-over; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F14 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R15 | anchor: A07
Parking parallels right with wheels inside 12 inches, brakes geared, and keys pocketed [A07].
Why it matters: group parking; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F15 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R16 | anchor: A07
Hills gear Park or Reverse downhill and First uphill with wheels curbed and brakes set [A07].
Why it matters: group hills; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F16 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R17 | anchor: A08
Bans clear 15 feet for hydrants, 20 for corners and stations, 30 for boxes and signs, and 50 for rails [A08].
Why it matters: group no-park; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F17 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec07-R18 | anchor: A08
Hill wheels curb downhill, uncurb uphill with curbs, and swing right uphill without [A08].
Why it matters: group hills; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R16; confusables sec07-F18 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec07-R19 | anchor: A09
Passes signal, room out, warn by horn or flash, return past visible tires, and clear before 200 feet [A09].
Why it matters: group passing; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F19 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec07-R20 | anchor: A09
Bans cover solids, short-sight hills and curves, 100-foot crossings, halted buses, and walker queues [A09].
Why it matters: group passing; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F20 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec07-R21 | anchor: A09
Passed drivers hold speed and slide right, and right-side passes need twin lanes or left-turning leaders [A09].
Why it matters: group passing; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F21 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec07-R22 | anchor: A10
Limits cap fair weather only, impacts square with speed, and no 10-over buffer shields tickets [A10].
Why it matters: group speed; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F23 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec07-R23 | anchor: A10
Standards read 20, 30, 55, and 70 by zone, while 70 postings floor at 50 [A10].
Why it matters: group speed; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F24 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec07-R24 | anchor: A11
HOV lanes double riders or decal clean cars behind diamond gates [A11].
Why it matters: group lanes; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F27 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec07-R25 | anchor: A11
Red lane-line reflectors demand instant correction and red edge reflectors demand pullovers [A11].
Why it matters: group reflectors; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F28 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec07-R26 | anchor: A12
Turns finish rights right and lefts anywhere lawful, and three-point turns dodge curves, hills, and highways [A12].
Why it matters: group turns; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F30, sec07-F31 [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0078]
